claim: Hang a chained thing (skeleton, lantern) at the height that matters, its body or lamp, and let the chain run up into the ceiling; never shrink the chain to fit a low room.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-21: 'you can simply let it sink into ceiling and it looks good.' Shrunk chains (repeat 32-40) read small and odd; Blood's own chains run into ceilings.
use: sprite_fit will report such a chain as 'through' the ceiling: expected. A layout-placed sprite still needs its origin (the chain's top for 689/641) under its sector's ceiling.
